description: The signed JSON tree. Reserved property names: owner, seq, signature, and { "#": hash } for a left-out part. An owner signs its branch down to the next owner. path is a list of keys.

added.hash(node): The hash a parent sees for node; a delegated branch counts only its owner block. Async.
added.contentHash(node): The hash of node's own content, which its owner signs. Async.
added.verify(tree, core): True if the root is owned by core and every signature checks out. Async.
added.verifyBranch(node): True if an owned node and every branch delegated from it check out. Async.
added.get(tree, path): The value at path, or undefined.
added.update(tree, path, value, entity): Sets (or deletes, if value is undefined) the value at path; the owner of that spot bumps seq and signs again. Throws if entity isn't that owner. Async.
added.delegate(tree, path, delegateEntity, ent: Gives the branch at path to delegateEntity, replacing what was there. The new owner then signs it. Async.

added.entityLists(tree, path): The entities lists a node at path can use for its owner id, nearest last.
added.findEntity(tree, path, id): The record a node at path would get for owner id, or null.
added.addEntity(tree, path, newEntity, entity): Adds newEntity to the entities list of the owned branch at path. Only its owner may. Async.

2.notes: owner is now an id, looked up in the entities lists of the owned branches above (nearest first, up to the root). delegate lists the new owner in the delegator's entities if it isn't known above. verifyBranch(node, lists) takes the lists from above. Trees with whole records in owner still work.
